messages.author: 98a3d43f8b16bc07
messages.subject: MQM for binary traits?
parts:
Hello,
Does mqmscan allow binary phenotypes? I get 'Error in if (phenovar > 1000) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed' on my cross object. If not, is there a strategy for using genotypes as covariates with scantwo? Any guidance is much appreciated!
Jeff

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] MQM for binary traits?
parts:
mqmscan doesn't include an option for a binary phenotype.

You could try stepwiseqtl().

The error doesn't seem to relate to a binary phenotype but rather than pheno component of the cross maybe being a plain matrix rather than a data frame.

Try

mycross$pheno <- as.data.frame(mycross$pheno)

karl
